copy.curiosityHook: Cut off in the freezing dark with threats on both sides of the reinforced steel, who orchestrates the assault, and who will outlast the night?
copy.description: During a routine transport in Spain, an armored prisoner van is ambushed on a desolate road. Trapped with volatile inmates, the officer in charge must fend off external assailants while surviving sub-zero cold.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, suspenseful, and frostbitten, pairing intense multi-sided danger with engaged, high-tension energy ideal for solo or group viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Lluís Quílez delivers a relentless, pressure-cooker Spanish thriller where ruthless human hostility collides with brutal freezing elements in a fast-paced battle for survival.

allowedMaterial: the officer in charge of the prisoner transport
threats from both inmates inside and attackers outside
freezing sub-zero temperatures as an environmental hazard
director Lluís Quílez and Spanish language setting
excludedMaterial: identity and motivations of the attacker
fate of the prisoners or guards
third-act escape attempts or climax resolution
